brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex cell (piece:0,0,0;full) closed with a solid top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top), solid end caps on all six side faces (cap:0,0,0;* at bearings 30-330), and joints locked via lockJoints. check_build reports ok, no issues, meshClash clear.

A louvred port (hex-port-louvre, port:0#0,0#0) is fitted in side slot 0 of the cell, passing air while the rest of the box stays capped. The configurator checks fit only, so actual airflow/heat performance of a real board cannot be verified here.
requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe

requirements.evidence: The closed cell provides a hollow interior volume for a board. No circuit-board prop exists in the prop catalogue, so the board itself is not staged; a coiled cable (prop:1) is placed beside the enclosure on the bench to indicate its electronics purpose. Internal mounting/thermal suitability for a specific board is outside what the configurator can check.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell electronics enclosure: a full hex base cell with a solid lid, solid end caps sealing all six side faces, joints locked, and one louvred port (hex-port-louvre) in a side face so air can pass while the box remains otherwise closed. A coiled cable beside it on the bench indicates its electronics use (no circuit-board prop exists to stage the board inside). Check passed with no issues and clear mesh collisions.

events.text: Closed electronics box with a breathing vent — I'll build the sealed enclosure, fit a louvred cover, and stage a board inside.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

events.text: There's no circuit-board prop in the catalogue, so I'll keep staging minimal — a cable coil beside the box to show its electronics purpose. First, the enclosure itself: lid on top, louvre vent on one face, and the remaining faces capped shut.

outcomes.message: the prop has no place to rest there: Overlaps the cell wall.
the prop has no place to rest there: Overlaps the cell wall.

tryInsteadSent.note: Each prop refused with a tryInstead was sent again as that tryInstead.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
